context:
Goal: a coordinator pick that a past ruling already covers is not brought to you as a question.
Problem (rule): PR #2932 judges a pick only in a message the coordinator sends to a running session; a pick written in the brief that starts a new lane session, or in a message to an agent, passes unjudged.
Based on (read): PR #2932 lists this as a known limit. Your 14:25 CST words: "we're literally trying to make changes to hooks and ure showing me how our old hooks/rules are the law stop that".
Departs from: today's live code judges no pick — PR #2932 judges messages to running sessions only; b also judges lane briefs and agent messages.
home: step pick-ack-past-ruling (a pick a past ruling covers is acked, not asked)

options.gain: A smaller check; fewer places an old ruling is quoted back at you.
options.how: The check stays as built; the known limit stays a note.
options.label: Session messages only (Recommended)
options.lose: A pick inside a lane brief is not judged.

options.how: The check also reads the brief that starts a lane and each message to an agent.
options.label: Lane briefs and agent messages too
options.lose: More places where an old ruling can be held up against a change you want.
